title: Batch Documents to Minimize Padding
hints: A batch's cost depends only on how many documents it holds and on its longest one. Ask yourself whether it can ever help to put a short document in the same batch as a long one while a medium-length document sits in a different batch.
After sorting, an optimal solution can be assumed to cut the sorted list into G contiguous groups. That turns the problem into choosing G − 1 cut points.
Think of the best cost for the first i sorted documents using g batches. The last batch is some suffix ending at i, and its cost is fixed by its size and its last (longest) element.
